About the Role: A suspicious web redirect is often just one step in a much larger chain. A traffic distribution system (TDS) decides where a visitor goes next based on signals such as their browser, location, referrer, or previous activity. In malicious campaigns, this can make the infrastructure difficult to observe and the final destination difficult to reach consistently. In this student position, you will investigate TDS infrastructure, understand its routing logic, and develop tools to capture browser activity, reconstruct redirection chains, and map the relationships between their components. The aim is to build a reusable approach to understanding how different TDS instances route visitors from an entry point to a final destination. The work will form the basis of your diploma thesis at Gen. With guidance from the team, you will develop your malware analysis and reverse engineering skills while using AI to help build and validate tooling for TDS research. Key Responsibilities: Analyze TDS infrastructure and investigate how it routes malicious traffic Reverse engineer and deobfuscate JavaScript to understand routing and evasion techniques Inspect and modify HTTP traffic, including headers, cookies, and redirects, using Chrome DevTools, Fiddler, Burp Suite, or similar tools Use AI to help develop and validate tools in JavaScript, Python, or other scripting languages for automated analysis and infrastructure mapping Test your findings and document the methods and results in your diploma thesis Perform other duties as instructed by your supervisor Interview Structure: The following steps have already been completed for the current candidate: Two discussions, one 60-minute session and one 30-minute session, covering the student's current skills, the homework assignment, mutual expectations, and the initial thesis direction A practical homework assignment, which the student successfully passed Initial alignment on a TDS-related diploma thesis; the detailed research question, deliverables, and evaluation criteria remain to be defined together

description: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team. Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers Who you are We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What the process will look like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. description: About us Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. You'll gain hands-on experience contributing to the design and development of AI agents, shipping features, and learning from real-world use cases at scale. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra. description: About Us: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: In 2027, Upvest is launching the PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions) on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers. This internship offers direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks. What you’ll do: Incoming and outgoing transfers: Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash. Counterparty and client relations: Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders. Controls and reconciliation: Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks. Fails and exception management: Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams. PEA tax continuity: Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved. Registered shares: Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations). Reporting and continuous improvement: actively monitor SLAs and KPIs, write operating procedures and identify automation opportunities. What you bring: Education: Master's degree (M1 or M2) in Finance, Banking, Economics or Law from a business school, engineering school or university; gap-year students and recent Master's graduates able to sign an internship agreement are welcome. Languages: You have native-level or bilingual proficiency in French (C2) and are comfortable working in English. Experience: A first experience in banking, back office, middle office or securities operations is a strong plus, as is knowledge of the PEA, post-trade or Euroclear France. Analytical mindset: Rigour, attention to detail and a taste for solving complex problems. Tools: You're confident with spreadsheets ; knowledge SQL/Python is a plus. How we Upvest in you: Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent. Our Values: Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection. Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together. Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others. Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Bracebridge Capital, LLC is a leading alternative asset manager with approximately $12 billion of net assets under management.  The firm pursues investment strategies primarily within the global fixed income markets with the objectives of capital preservation and absolute return without significant correlation to equity, interest rate and foreign exchange markets.  Established in 1994, Bracebridge manages private investment funds that serve endowments, foundations, pension funds and other institutional and high-net-worth investors.

Approximately 170 employees operate from our office located in Boston’s historic Back Bay. The entrepreneurial and collaborative culture at Bracebridge rewards and supports motivated, dedicated, enthusiastic and intellectually curious individuals. We believe our firm’s greatest asset is the people who work here.

Bracebridge is seeking to hire a talented graduate student as a co-op in our Quantitative Research department.  The co-op will report to the Manager of the ABS Business Intelligence group and will be exposed to all aspects of the data acquisition process, including requirements definition, development, testing, implementation and maintenance. 

Primary Responsibilities: 
•    Learn, maintain, support and enhance the existing data acquisition framework
•    Create new applications, reports and automated tests using the existing framework
•    Design and maintain tools to analyze the performance of preproduction code
•    Build out the data acquisition framework for new providers and asset classes
•    Improve product documentation 

Required Skills and Credentials:
•    Top academic credentials in pursuit of a MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or Information Systems
•    Experience with .NET development platform preferred
•    Experience with C# or Java
•    Strong object-oriented programming skills
•    SQL skills
•    Ability to critically evaluate and improve current processes 
•    Proven ability to produce quality work under time pressure 
•    Excellent technical skills as well as the ability to work collaboratively with others
•    Intellectual curiosity and an eagerness to learn

 

Current anticipated annual base salary range: $43 - $48/hour

Base salary within the range will be determined by various factors including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills and qualifications.

#LI-Onsite

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

description:

Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems leveraging cutting edge (AI) capabilities within our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in enterprise technology sales.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges. You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the DACH market.

The work you’ll do:

  • Analyze data from our customers to increase transparency in business processes
  • Understand the pain points of our customers and translate them into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
  • Translate customer pain points into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform, quantify financial impact and prepare management ready presentations
  • Collaborate with customers to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives and AI Strategy
  • Present findings together with your team in front of customers’ C-level and decision makers
  • Leverage Celonis data modeling and AI capabilities to uncover process inefficiencies, generate insights, and deliver high impact, data driven value propositions to clients.
  • Pitch the Celonis AI value proposition and vision to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy
  • Prototype and develop AI solutions tailored to customer needs, including both traditional machine learning, LLM-based solutions and orchestration technology
  • Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen

The qualifications you need:

  • Student of Business Analytics/ Business Informatics / Technology & Management / (Industrial) Engineering / AI/ML / Mathematics or of a comparable program
  • Strong communicational skills and interest in interacting with potential customers
  • Confidence to present to C-level executives and larger audiences
  • Have a passion for technology, data, OpenAI and LLMs and the impact it can have on the world
  • Knowledge in SQL and Python or related database query languages (completion of Celonis "Rising Star" modules would be a plus)
  • Experience in consulting and highly interested in Data Analytics, focused on creating and adding value for customers
  • Analytical mindset and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and execute
  • Effective communicator and business fluent in German and English

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

description:
About Didi Autonomous Driving

Founded in 2016, DiDi's autonomous driving unit is dedicated to developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology to make transportation safer, more efficient, and accessible. In 2019, the unit became an independent company, Voyager, to accelerate technology development, commercialization, and large-scale deployment. By combining DiDi's unique data advantage, operational expertise, and mobility ecosystem, we aim to build a reliable, scalable autonomous fleet that integrates seamlessly with human-driven services. Driven by real-world customer needs and a strong commitment to safety and user experience, our mission is to deliver autonomous mobility solutions that create meaningful value for riders and communities.

 

About the Role

We want our vehicles to understand the physical world as it is right now, instead of relying on a map drawn long ago. Roads change, and the world a car actually drives in is always more complex than any static record of it. We are seeking a Research Intern to help give our planner a more accurate and up-to-date picture of the world, so the vehicle handles complex real-world scenes more robustly. In this role, you will take on hard, open problems from real-world driving and solve them with frontier research methods. You will report directly to the team lead and work on the problem from definition to validated solution. Strong results will often be worth publishing, and we will support you in writing them up, but the goal is to solve problems that matter to the product.

 

Responsibilities

  •  Survey the latest research in scene understanding, prediction, and planning, and turn it into practical approaches that fit our system and constraints.

  •  Design and implement deep learning models that build a richer, real-time understanding of the driving environment from onboard sensors and other available sources.

  •  Train and evaluate models on large-scale data from our driving logs and on public benchmarks, and lead failure analysis to find out where and why models fall short.

  •  Define metrics and evaluation methods that connect perception quality to how the vehicle actually drives.

  •  Turn successful prototypes into solutions that work with our planning stack, with help from production engineers.

  •  Collaborate with Perception, Prediction, Planning, and Mapping teams so results move from experiment to product.

  

Qualifications

  •  Currently enrolled in an M.S. or Ph.D. program in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, for the full duration of the internship.

  • Available for a full-time onsite internship of 3–6 months; start dates are flexible.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

Interested to learn more about our AI CAP Program? We will have our in-person Open House at our CHI office office on November 23rd (RSVP here: https://partiful.com/e/53eY3haJAUxm6leyFo5v)

About the Role

We are seeking an AI Product intern who will work on real AI agentic automation problems, designing, prototyping, and developing AI-powered agents to help the business and engineers achieve faster, smarter work. You will collaborate directly with senior engineers and architects, receiving mentorship and design reviews, and gaining exposure to modern GenAI patterns, including agent orchestration, tool-calling, retrieval, and evaluation, within an enterprise and fast-paced fintech environment.

AI tools change every quarter. Your project will use the best models, agent frameworks, and protocols available in summer 2027. You will work on current practice, not today's stack.

Launch your career developing real, impactful AI solutions in the lightning-fast world of fintech!

Program Details
Our summer program will be 10-12 weeks from May - August 2027 with the expectation of being in the office 3-4 days per week, as determined by the sponsor. Compensation will be set at an hourly rate of $35-40 per hour. Top performing associates may have the opportunity to be considered for full-time roles at DriveWealth at the conclusion of the program, based on performance and team needs. Must have a graduation date in 2027 or 2028 .

What You’ll Do

  • Design, prototype, and develop agentic AI workflows that automate or augment business or engineering tasks (for example, analysis, triage, documentation, and knowledge synthesis)
  • Build internal tools or proof-of-concept systems that combine LLMs, APIs, and automation frameworks into end-to-end agentic solutions
  • Experiment with different agent architectures (single-agent vs. multi-agent, planner/executor patterns, human-in-the-loop workflows) and document tradeoffs
  • Apply best practices when building AI-driven automation
  • Evaluate agent behavior for reliability, correctness, and failure modes, and propose improvements
  • Clearly document designs, experiments, and lessons learned so work can be reused or extended by the team
  • Demo your work directly to customers and the leadership team

What You’ll Need

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience programming in Python (for automation, prototyping, and scripting) and SQL
  • Familiarity with APIs, JSON, and basic service integration
  • Foundational understanding of large language models and how they are used in applications (prompting, tool use, retrieval, etc.)
  • Strong curiosity and willingness to explore new, rapidly evolving technologies
  • A growth mindset: you ask questions and enjoy experimenting and iterating
  • Systems thinking: able to reason about workflows, edge cases, and unintended consequences
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining technical ideas to non-engineers
  • Ownership mindset: you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Ability to accept feedback and iterate quickly


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth is unable to sponsor an employment Visa at this time.

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

About the company 

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.  

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive. 

Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume.  Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.

Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable.  We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society. 

We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.  

Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.  

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. 

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. 

About This Role

General Matter builds its own technology: the software, firmware, control systems, and infrastructure that run an industrial nuclear fuel facility. At most companies, a security bug costs you data. Here, the software we build, and any security vulnerabilities we miss, touch the real world. The Security team's job is to find those gaps before anyone else does. We do that through offensive testing, code audits, design reviews, and hardening the systems we ship. 

As an intern on the team, you'll attack General Matter's products and infrastructure, while working with the engineers who own them to fix what you find. Targets include web apps, APIs, Linux and Windows hosts, cloud environments, embedded devices, and industrial controllers. You'll own real projects from start to finish, and you won't be writing policy documents

Responsibilities

  • Break everything you touch, then help us fix it. 
  • Run penetration tests against General Matter networks, services, web applications, and APIs. Prove what you find with working proof-of-concept exploits. 
  • Audit source code and features for security vulnerabilities in languages like Python, C, C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript. Then build static analysis rules or CI checks so the same class of bug can't come back. 
  • Reverse engineer and attack embedded devices and industrial equipment on an isolated test bench. That includes firmware extraction, binary analysis on x86 and ARM, debug interfaces (JTAG, SWD, UART), and PLC and industrial protocol implementations (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA). 
  • Do threat modeling and adversarial design reviews with software, controls, and hardware engineers. Help design a secure architecture for systems before they ship. 
  • Assess third-party software, devices, and services before they get into our environment, and work with vendors and suppliers to get the issues fixed. 
  • Attack cloud and identity infrastructure, including IAM misconfigurations, exposed secrets, privilege escalation paths, and CI/CD supply chain weaknesses. 
  • Build automated tooling that spots known security exposures and keeps running after your internship ends. 
  • Present your findings and fixes to the engineers and leaders who own the systems. 

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field 
  • Security experience in one or more of the following: C, C++, Rust, Go, Python, x86, ARM, cryptography, reverse engineering, embedded systems, or network protocols. 
  • A strong understanding of common vulnerability classes and how to exploit them, such as SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, memory corruption, and authentication or authorization flaws. 
  • Experience auditing code and features, and comfort reading large codebases you didn't write. 
  • Strong investigative and analytical problem-solving skills. You keep digging after the obvious attacks fail.

  • Product Pricing & Modeling: Assist in building, maintaining, and running actuarial projection models (such MG-ALFA or Excel-based tools) to evaluate the profitability of life and annuity products.

  • Assumption Setting: Work with key pricing assumptions such as mortality, lapse rates, and expenses to gain an understanding for the impact they have on product profitability.  Gain exposure to experience data as a way to learn how assumptions are developed.

Pay Range: $26/hour.  Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

This is a hands-on role for a highly motivated engineer who is excited to learn quickly, solve difficult physical problems, and see their work built and tested. You may contribute across the engineering lifecycle from CAD design and drawings to analysis, procurement, assembly, testing, and vehicle integration.

  • Exposure to structural or thermal analysis tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar
  • Experience with machining, sheet metal, composites, additive manufacturing, or other fabrication processes
  • Familiarity with test instrumentation, data acquisition, or laboratory testing practices

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

  • Strong coding ability in R and/or Python, passionate about data science and the technology industry. Some experience with SQL is a plus.
  • Experience with and technical understanding of statistical modeling & machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with big data/deploying models into production is a plus (Spark, AWS, Docker, Flask, plumber).
  • A passion for social media (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, etc.) is a big plus.

  • A passion for data science - you care about performing unbiased & rigorous analysis.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills - you come with not only creative solutions but also understand the right questions that need to be asked when needed.
  • Strong customer service orientation - everything we do is in service of our clients.
  • Business acumen - making sure your work is practical and useful
  • Strong communication skills - we are a team, we expect you to work collaboratively across all functions. You will have constant communication with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, agile environment where critical thinking and strong problem solving skills are imperative.

Application Process: 

If you think you would be a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume, cover letter, and an unofficial transcript - please highlight relevant courses or other academic achievements, competitions etc.  And if you have a personal portfolio or Git account, send us the links so we can see how you shine. 

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted. 

Additionally, all permanent team members are granted stock options and are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:  $4,000 per month

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

About Moment Energy

Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it.

Energy should be free.  Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone.

The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy.

Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact.

We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale.

Now is the moment. Join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Test Engineering Co-op to join our Test Engineering team. We recently unveiled our new manufacturing facility, the largest second-life battery repurposing facility in the world, and are quickly ramping up our testing and production capacity..

This is a hands-on role, with lots of time in our new R&D lab and around the production floor. You will set up and run test benches, troubleshoot complex issues across multiple subsystems, and command massive amounts of electrical power. You’ll get exposure to every level of the stack from building custom prototyping harnesses to wrangling data from DAQs.

In this role, you will directly support the development and testing of our energy storage products while gaining hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Assist the test engineering team in validating and improving energy storage products
  • Set up, configure, and maintain instruments and test benches for battery systems and power electronics
  • Assemble and modify electrical assemblies including wire harnessing, soldering, crimping, and circuit board assembly
  • Configure, debug, and operate devices via different communication protocols (CAN, Modbus, TCP/IP, serial)
  • Develop test plans, execute testing, analyze data, and write technical reports

The Student we’re looking for:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Strong preference for students with Design Team experience
  • Career interest in clean tech, energy systems, or electronics
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics
  • Some experience with Python or similar scripting tools
  • Hands-on experience with soldering, circuit boards, wiring, harness building, system integration or prototyping (academic or project-based experience welcome)
  • Ability to use 3D printing, hand tools, or power tools to build test fixtures
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment

The Experience You’ll Gain:

  • Hands-on experience developing real energy storage hardware
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers
  • Exposure to prototyping, testing, and certification processes
  • The opportunity to contribute to technology that supports the clean energy transition

 

Moment Energy Co-op Benefits Highlights

Paid Time Off: Co-op’s receive three paid days off per term

Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga and fitness center), and free EV charging on-site.

 

 

Why join us?

  • Today, we’re delivering 5x the energy density and have all the certifications needed to ship energy independence to the world.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company focused on creating sustainable energy solutions and making a positive impact on the world.
  • Collaborate closely with passionate co-founders and a team committed to innovation and excellence.
  • Contribute to building and scaling a company from the ground up, where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact.
  • Thrive in a workplace that values collaboration, wellness, and celebrating successes, with regular company socials, fitness sessions, and more.

 

We're a fast-paced and dynamic team.

Every day you'll be taking on a new challenge and learning something new. You'll take on a wide breadth of tasks and contribute to disrupting the battery industry. You'll be part of a tight-knit team that is working together to save the planet! Interns spend their summer pushing production-level code to make lasting contributions across MongoDB’s products and services for our internal teams, external customers, and developer end users.

This is a 12-week internship starting in May or June 2027.

What we are looking for in you (qualifications)

  • In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Have a foundation in computer science theory, with proficiencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
  • Fluent in any one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Go, C++, Javascript, Node.js - or a comparable object-oriented programming language.
  • Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. Graduation date in Fall 2027, Spring 2028, Summer 2028, Fall 2028, Spring 2029 or Summer 2029.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. 

What you'll find at MongoDB

  • Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work, we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation.
  • Personalized Mentorship: Pair up with an engineering Mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to foster your growth.
  • Career Coaching Sessions: Access to a tailored training program designed uniquely for interns’ personal and professional development.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Embrace "Bloom for Interns" with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more!
  • Impactful Projects: Contribute to projects where you can Make it Matter - your meaningful work will see the light of day.
  • Exclusive Networking: Attend "Speaker Series" and "Get to Knows" to connect with our executives and departmental leaders.
  • Vibrant Community: Build connections with fellow interns and join after-work social events, virtual gatherings, and local city activities to create connections and friendships.
  • Relocation Support: Financial assistance, housing, and a commuting stipend to allow you to comfortably settle into your new location.
  • Path to Full-Time: A chance to see if MongoDB is where you see yourself long term with the possibility of receiving a full time offer at the end of the summer!

MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours/week) for 12 consecutive weeks beginning in May or June and ending in August or September. All interns are considered hybrid employees, designated the "in office" working model and are expected to be in their office location 3-5 days a week.

Due to the high volume of applications our Early Talent Recruitment Team receives, it may take up to six weeks to hear back regarding an update on your application status. Our goal is to get back sooner, but we appreciate your patience as our team carefully reviews each application.

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MORSE Corp is an employee owned, small business based in Cambridge, MA, Arlington, VA, and Seattle, WA with a history of fielding cutting-edge technology. MORSE is passionate about fielding technology to our users, and to field more effectively, we are expanding in-house production capabilities with more complex and higher volume manufacturing.

We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer Co-op with an entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset—a true "doer" who is excited to help stand up processes and physical capabilities. You will participate in the production of first prototype builds, help set up initial assembly lines, and assist with manufacturing ramp-up.   • Assist in establishing and scaling manufacturing processes from R&D prototype builds to repeatable, fieldable production.

  • Interface with mechanical and electrical design engineers early in development to ensure designs transition smoothly into production.

  • Author and refine visual Work Instructions (WIs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), setup sheets, routers, and quality control documentation.

  • Design, prototype, and validate assembly jigs, fixtures, and Go/No-Go inspection gauges to ensure repeatable, high-yield production.

  • Participate in root cause analysis (RCA), yield optimization projects, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Assist with Quality Management System (QMS) activities, including PFMEAs, Engineering Change Orders (ECO/ECN), incoming inspections, and first-article testing.

  • Work hands-on with technicians and assembly personnel to ensure processes are followed safely, efficiently, and accurately.

  • Coordinate with external fabrication vendors and contract manufacturers (CMs) for custom tooling, parts procurement, and outsourced processes.

  • Support the maintenance of manufacturing Bills of Materials (BOMs) and routings within our ERP system.

Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required along with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

  • Able to commit to a full-time 6 month co-op term from January through June 2027 

  • Eager to get in on the ground floor as a high-initiative, hands-on "doer" who enjoys building processes and capabilities from scratch.

  • Proven ability to coordinate among multiple shifting priorities and flourish in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Fluent in SolidWorks & 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX) for the design, documentation, and lifecycle management of parts, large assemblies, drawings, and metadata.

  • Ability to design and implement assembly jigs, fixtures, and Go/No-Go inspection gauges to ensure repeatable, high-yield production.

  • Understanding of LEAN manufacturing and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) principles with a history of ownership and execution of process improvement projects.

  • Experienced with quality management systems (ISO9001), including document control, ECN/ECO processes, PPAP, NPI gates, and conducting PFMEAs to mitigate production risks.

  • Proficient in GD&T (ASME Y14.5 standards), drawing reviews, and performing tolerance stack-up analyses to ensure parts fit consistently during mass assembly.

  • Experience utilizing ERP/MRP systems to manage Bills of Materials (BOMs), establish manufacturing routings, and support operational workflows.

 

MORSE Corp’s pay range for this role carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to, prior experience, education, skills and expertise, location, internal equity, and other factors that are job related and consistent with business need. Therefore, final offer amounts may vary from the amount stated.

Compensation
$27—$33 USD

The team at MORSE takes pride in being the smart team that is easy to work with. We focus on steady, long-term success while maintaining a collaborative, enjoyable work experience for our employees. For more information, please visit www.morsecorp.com.

About the role

Muon is seeking Ground Software Engineering Interns to help build the software that powers high-performance satellite constellations. The Software Engineering team at Muon is responsible for software on the spacecraft, at ground stations, in the cloud, and visualization and simulation. As an intern, you won't be on the sidelines, you can look forward to owning a project from start to finish which could involve enabling a new type of task for the spacecraft, simulating a new component, writing the software for a new piece of hardware, or deploying new algorithms for processing images and other sensor data from the spacecraft.

Muon is a fast growing company which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. You'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry, in an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success. Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules, and the internship is full-time and on-site in Mountain View or San Jose, CA.

  • Own a well-scoped software project from design through implementation and testing, with mentorship from experienced engineers at each stage.

  • Propose and iterate on software designs with guidance from the team.
  • Participate in code reviews and document your work so other engineers can use and maintain it.
  • Collaborate with software and hardware engineers and gain hands-on experience building reliable software for spacecraft.

  • Coursework or practical experience in data structures, algorithms, and software development fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in a programming language (e.g., Python, C++, Rust).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to break down problems, test assumptions, and work through bugs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Previous internship or co-op experience or experience on a software engineering team 
  • Knowledge of a specific satellite subsystem or domain, such as orbital mechanics, RF communications, or power systems
  • Previous experience building and deploying SaaS applications on IaaS platforms
  • Previous experience building or training ML models

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. description:
About NewsBreak

Local life runs on local information. What happened down the street? Who can fix this? Where should we go tonight? NewsBreak started in 2015 to answer these questions, and today more than 40 million people a month rely on us to follow what’s going on in their zip code.

Three platforms with one vision: powering local life. Led by founder and CEO Jeff Zheng, NewsBreak is our local life and news platform; Nearby AI connects people with local businesses; and NDot AI helps publishers and creators grow and earn.

Building for the long term. A $115 million Series C made us a unicorn in 2021, and we keep investing in our people. We’re Great Place to Work® certified and named to Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025) and Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ (2026).

Everyone makes an impact. Whether you write code, shape products, tell our story, or run the business, we want people who own projects end to end, stay curious, and speak up. Join us.

Learn more at: NewsBreak, Nearby AI, NDot AI

About the role

NewsBreak is building ReelBee, an open short-drama distribution platform where any qualified creator or studio can self-publish, earn a transparent revenue share, and get real US audience insights. This is a CEO-sponsored, company-level initiative. As a Creative Editor Intern you will cut the trailers and paid-social creatives that bring viewers to great short dramas, and learn directly from performance data what makes people stop scrolling. This is a 3–6 month internship (at least 24 hours per week) with 2 openings, hiring in parallel in the SF Bay Area (Mountain View) and Beijing.

Pay: $22–$30 per hour (US), depending on experience and location.

What you'll do

  • Cut short dramas into 15–60 second trailers and acquisition creatives (9:16, hook in the first 3 seconds) for Meta, TikTok and Google ads and in-app recommendations, mainly for titles whose partners did not supply creatives or supplied ones that fall short
  • Run quality checks on creatives submitted by content partners (specs, subtitles, hook, ad-platform policy compliance) and lightly re-edit those that do not pass
  • Each week, produce batches of creative variants (different hooks, end CTAs, subtitle styles) per the growth team's test plan, and iterate based on CTR/CPI data
  • Run TikTok / YouTube Shorts / Instagram short-drama channels: edit highlight clips and commentary-style content and keep a steady posting rhythm
  • Use AI tools (auto-subtitles, voice-over, translation, smart editing) to raise output and build reusable creative templates

What we're looking for

  • Currently enrolled or a recent graduate in film, media, design or a related field, with short-form video editing work to show (please include portfolio links)
  • Proficiency in at least one of Premiere, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve; After Effects or motion graphics a plus
  • A heavy user of short dramas or vertical video who understands hooks and beat-matching, and can explain why an ad creative makes people stop
  • Curious about data: willing to look at CTR and CPI and edit accordingly, not just for looks
  • Able to read and write English subtitles; familiarity with overseas social ad guidelines is a plus
  • Familiarity with AI editing, subtitle and voice tools is a plus

In this Co-Op/Internship you’ll work at the intersection of optics, atomic physics, and data science. The QPU Build team designs and implements system-wide features of QuEra’s neutral-atom quantum computer architecture. You’ll work hands-on in the lab characterizing the optical systems that trap and control atoms and turn those measurements into insights that drive improvements across the machine. Along the way, you’ll get a holistic view of how a quantum computer is designed and built at QuEra Computing Inc.

Responsibilities

  • Optical Measurements: Design and run measurements to characterize optical components and systems used in neutral-atom quantum computing, including lasers, beam-shaping optics, and atom-trapping setups. Assist with building, aligning, and troubleshooting optical setups in the lab.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze measurement and experimental data using the Python scientific stack. Build tools and workflows that make results reproducible, and turn findings into clear, actionable feedback for the team.
  • System Integration Support: Work with physicists and engineers to bring optical subsystems into the broader atomic physics pipeline and help identify ways to improve performance and reliability.

Qualifications

  • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in physics, optics/photonics, engineering, or a related field.
  • Hands-on optics lab experience (e.g., alignment, beam characterization, working with lasers and optical components) is required.
  • Strong Python programming skills for data analysis (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Strong evidence of independent work.
  • A deep background in quantum physics isn’t required, but a solid foundation in physics and mathematics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with holography, spatial light modulators, diffractive optics and/or metasurfaces.
  • Experience with CAD design in Autodesk Inventor and/or optical design in Zemax.
  • Exposure to atomic physics or quantum computing experiments.

This is an on-site Co-Op/Internship. Relocation is not offered for this role. Immediate start date preferred.

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

Scale's Machine Learning Research team builds the foundation for the next generation of AI systems — pushing the boundaries of what's possible with frontier models while ensuring safety, reliability, and alignment at every step. Our work spans generative AI, reinforcement learning and advanced post-training methods, scalable oversight, synthetic data pipelines, red teaming, and evaluation science.

We are developing a large-scale hybrid human-machine system to power machine learning pipelines for dozens of industry-leading customers. These models and systems form the backbone of Scale's long-term strategy, enabling billions of tasks monthly and supporting some of the most complex and advanced use cases in the AI ecosystem.

As an intern, you'll work on a combination of deeply technical ML applications in production and cutting-edge research problems, with mentorship from world-class researchers and the opportunity to collaborate with leading teams across industry and academia. Interns own real, published or shipped work — not side projects.

Example Projects

  • Measure the dangerous capabilities of frontier models and conduct preparedness research
  • Research the science and creation of new benchmarks for frontier models
  • Develop new methods for training models to excel on extremely difficult reasoning problems that require long chains of thought
  • Research reinforcement learning and post-training methods that improve model reliability on high-stakes tasks
  • Research scalable oversight protocols that enable humans to produce and quality control reasoning chains beyond their native capabilities
  • Study the boundaries of model generalization and capabilities to inform data-driven advancements
  • Research synthetic and hybrid data with humans in the loop to scale up high-quality data generation
  • Take models currently in production, identify areas for improvement, improve them using retraining and hyperparameter searches, then deploy without regressing on core model characteristics
  • Create post-training or agentic solutions that integrate into our ability to deliver applications for enterprise and public sector clients

Required to Have

  • Currently enrolled in a BS, MS or PhD program with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Natural Language Processing, with a graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028
  • Available for a Summer 2027 internship (May/June start dates) in San Francisco Or New York.
  • Prior research experience or a track record of publications on LLMs, NLP, multimodal models, agents, safety, evaluation, alignment, or a related field
  • Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages, including Python, Javascript, or similar

Ideally You'd Have

  • A previous internship in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Adversarial Robustness, Alignment, Evaluation, or Agents
  • Experience as a researcher — through internships, full-time roles, or at a lab
  • Publications at top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, EMNLP or AAAI, or contributions to open source projects
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, agentic systems, or evaluation infrastructure

How We Work

Our credos shape how we make decisions and work as a team:

  • Earn Customer Love — trust is earned with every interaction, every delivery, and every problem we solve
  • Team Flow — ideas, energy, and support move freely across teams; optimize for the whole
  • Quality is Our Cheat Code — the systems that deliver quality consistently are a structural advantage
  • Find the 20% — find the inputs that drive the outcomes and execute them completely
  • Write the Market — our research puts us at the frontier, and we bring our partners there first
  • Three Moves Ahead — consider the consequences of consequences, and plan accordingly

We’re seeking a highly motivated PhD student in economics to join our Central Research team in the Discretionary Macro and Fixed Income Division in New York. What You’ll Do

As part of a close-knit team, you’ll build tools and analyze large datasets to generate actionable macroeconomic insights for portfolio managers. Your work may include:

  • Building quantitative models covering growth, inflation, labor markets, and monetary and fiscal policy across developed and emerging markets
  • Conducting empirical research on macro themes such as policy transmission, term premia, and cross-country spillovers
  • Developing and maintaining data and analytical tools that the broader research team can use
  • Communicating findings clearly to researchers and portfolio managers, so your work informs live investment decisions

What You’ll Bring

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in Economics, Financial Economics, or a related quantitative field

  • A genuine interest in financial markets and how macro research connects to investment decisions
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Operations Intern, you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes. 

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

  • Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.
  • Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

  • Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. 

Compensation: The salary for the Chargeback Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

#Full-time 

Pay Range
$800—$800 USD

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Location & Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with 5 days per week onsite in Needham, MA.  There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position. 

Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early career talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. description:
At Sigma, we’re not just adding AI—we’re building the future of how people work with data. Our platform already lets users explore billions of rows of data in seconds with a spreadsheet-like interface, analyze and present their data in workbooks, and build data apps and workflows. Now we’re pushing further, applying AI to reshape how people build in Sigma, discover insights, and make smarter decisions—fast.

Our internship program at Sigma:

As an Intern at Sigma, you’ll work on documentation for various production features and learn best practices of developing user assistance for enterprise software in a fast-paced release environment. Our interns work directly with our engineers, product leaders, and designers across the organization everyday. We’re looking for students who bring curiosity, a spirit for collaboration, and a desire for shaping the future of agentic workflows for app development, business insights, and data exploration.

Internship Program Qualifications:

  • Current student: 
    • Applicants must be currently enrolled in a university undergraduate or graduate degree program in the U.S with a graduation date of December 2027 or later
    • Able to intern from June 2027 through August 2027 (flexible)
  • Authorization: 
    • You must be legally authorized to work in the US during the Summer 2027 program
    • Visa sponsorship is not available for our internship positions, but we welcome applicants on a student visa (with authorization to work in the U.S.) to apply
  • Location: 
    • Applicants must be able to work in-person in our office in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY for the duration of their internship.
    • Relocation assistance will be provided for students who will need to relocate for the summer in the form of a relocation bonus. 

About the role:

As a Technical Writing Intern, you will test and document new product features that help our global user base analyze and gather insights from their data. During your internship, you’ll partner directly with your tech writer mentor, as well as collaborate with other teams across the business to deliver a significant new documentation project that benefits our customers. You will collaborate across the company to determine the best solution for your technical challenge. Interns will take their project from ideation through implementation, iterating and gathering feedback along the way. Potential projects include developing new tutorials and examples, creating video and gif content to illustrate key concepts, or implementing information architecture transformations to optimize content for AI agents. 

During your internship you will:

  • Write clear and accurate documentation that enables Sigma customers to use the product to effectively and efficiently achieve their goals. 
  • Deploy documentation and gather insights from customer metrics to aid you in making better decisions and improve your business acumen and collaboration skills.
  • Work closely with the development team (including engineers, designers, and product managers) throughout the development process to understand features and functionality at the level of a subject matter expert.
  • Participate in cross-functional planning, bug bashes, and strategic discussions. 
  • Explore and validate product features through rigorous testing, sharing insights with the team.
  • Translate complex technical details into clear, digestible documentation and release notes.
  • Work collaboratively and closely with other writers to ensure consistent and cohesive content, style, and messaging.
  • Draft, review, and publish content in a docs-as-code workflow with AI tooling in the loop.
  • Improve existing documentation based on feedback from customer-facing teams and actively address knowledge gaps, prioritizing user empowerment for all audiences.
  • Develop visually captivating, dynamic documentation that includes diagrams, screenshots, and other visual aids.

What we’re looking for:

A cover letter is required for applications to be considered. Please share why you’re interested in Sigma and how you meet the criteria listed in this "What we're looking for" section.

  • Applicants must be pursuing at least a Bachelor’s or a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Exceptional written and spoken communication skills, emphasizing clarity and approachability for various audiences.
  • A genuine desire to learn new things daily and to translate complex topics into actionable user assistance for end users. 
  • Solid project management and communication abilities. You love to find the right resources and can own tasks end to end with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in a team environment.
  • Able to commit 40 hrs a week for 12 weeks in-person in our San Francisco, CA or New York, NY office 

Additional job details

Interns at Sigma are compensated with an hourly rate and relocation bonus (where applicable). Our hourly rate for this role ranges from $36.00 - $42.00 per hour.

Note: We have an in-office work environment in both our SF & NYC office.

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma

About the Company:

At SK Hynix Memory Solution, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in DRAM and NAND flash technologies, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

 

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Intern SSD Mechanical Engineer to join our hardware development team.
